module: Milestones related to career deliveries: parcels, vehicles, trailers, fluids and dry bulk delivered; on-time, delayed or late deliveries (parcelMods "timed"); number of facilities served (deliverToMilestone) or that received deliveries (deliverFromMilestone). Values come from career_modules_delivery_progress and career_modules_delivery_parcelMods.
notes: Tiers: parcel {5,25,50,100,150,250}, vehicle and trailer {1,4,9,25,35,50}, fluid and dryBulk {100,1000,10000,100000}, timed {1,8,20,50}, supplier facilities {1,4,9,16,25}, recipients {1,4,9,16,25,35,45}.
All milestones use minorLinear (100*(step+1)) and the delivery/gameplay filter.
The labels of deliverToMilestone/deliverFromMilestone seem inverted relative to the key names (deliveredFromHere for deliverToMilestone): to verify in the translations.
Unlike the other subsystems, the save data of these milestones is not created here (it is created by milestones/general.lua).

onGeneralMilestonesCollect.desc: Hook: builds the delivery milestone configurations and adds them to milestonesList.

onGeneralMilestonesSetupCallbacks.desc: Hook: sets the notification target of each delivery milestone.

setNotificationTarget.desc: Stores in milestoneConfig._target the target of the next tier to notify, unless all are notified.

onDeliveryFacilityProgressStatsChanged.desc: Hook called when the delivery facility progress statistics change: checks each milestone, notifies the reached tiers and advances notificationStep.
